sorry_inventory.why_deferred: ROOT SORRY. The backward proof needs: (1) formula unfolding + nf_x/x extraction, (2) atom part via backward_2var_nf_agreement, (3) quantifier part h_quant. (B) Alternative: restructure the formula to directly encode all quantifier conditions, not just interval ones, then backward proof extracts all conditions from formula truth.
